title: Selections from the Writings of the Bab
author: The Bab
description: A selection of the Bab's writings on revelation, devotion and spiritual renewal. The collection introduces a religious vision that prepared the way for the Baha'i faith and invites reflection on humanity's relationship with the divine.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
